cohort: 3012 women who gave birth in Tosamaganga Hospital, Tanzania, from 1 January to 30 June 2014 and from 1 March to 30 November 2015
finding: The study found a high overall CS rate (35.2%), particularly in low-risk patient groups (Robson groups 1 and 3), highlighting a potential need for improved labor management and timely referrals at the hospital.
